children: MultiversX rolls out the Supernova v2.0.5.0 releases across its networks. The public testnet and devnet receive the new builds T2.0.5.0 and D2.0.5.0 in the morning UTC, and the mainnet upgrade to v2.0.5.0 follows in the afternoon UTC. The rollout locks in the path toward the Supernova epoch activation set for 10 Sep.

The staged sequence lets validators and builders observe testnet and devnet behavior before mainnet adopts the same release on the same day. With v2.0.5.0 live on mainnet, the remaining step is the Supernova epoch activation on 10 Sep, giving participants a concrete, dated milestone to track between rollout and activation.
Update on our Supernova release timeline:
Public Testnet and Devnet upgrades are now scheduled for tomorrow morning with the Mainnet upgrade following in the afternoon.
A change landed during final testing today which will run on our internal Testnet overnight.

title: MultiversX: Supernova v2.0.5.0 Reaches Testnet, Devnet, and Mainnet - 02 Sep 2026
